description: notify.channel.enable refused with the secret-missing family: the channel row exists but its reference resolves to nothing in the secrets store, and enabling it would let it send UNSIGNED bodies — the receiver could not tell Aeon from a forger. The todo names the fix (write the secret from a 0600 file, then enable).

data.what: notify: the channel has no secret — set one with --secret-file
data.means: every delivery is signed with HMAC-SHA256 so the receiver can tell Aeon from a forger; an enabled channel without a secret could only send unsigned bodies, which is why enabling is where the absence surfaces
data.todo: write the secret first: notify.channel.update with secretFile naming a 0600 file on the daemon host (aeon channel set-secret --secret-file PATH from the CLI), then enable
